summary: Build practical governance skills with DAMA DMBOK, COBIT, and data quality tools. Book Master Data Governance for Business Teams Training.
lede: Master Data Governance for Business Teams helps business functions create reliable, traceable data practices across customer, supplier, and product records. You will learn to clarify ownership, strengthen standards, monitor quality, and manage exceptions across fragmented systems. The course provides practical experience with ownership matrices, RACI maps, quality scorecards, issue logs, metadata registers, stewardship workflows, and governance meeting templates. You will also explore how catalog and lineage tools support accountability, assess governance maturity, and build control artifacts that support reporting, compliance readiness, analytics, and AI use cases.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own, manage, or depend on master data governance in business operations.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of business data flows, operational reporting, and cross-functional process ownership. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing data definitions, ownership responsibilities, and quality issues in spreadsheets, dashboards, or a data catalog interface. Familiarity with basic governance concepts, such as policies, controls, and escalation paths, will help you move faster through the applied exercises.
